Tafsir al-Jalalayn on surah 107, verse 1:

﴿Have you seen the one who denies the Religion?﴾ i.e., the recompense and the reckoning. That is, do you know him, even if you do not know him?

Tafsir al-Jalalayn (al-Mahalli and al-Suyuti), on Surah 107, verse 2:

﴿فَذَلِكَ﴾ (That one) — with the implied supposition "هُوَ" (he is) placed after the fa' — ﴿الَّذِي يَدُعّ اليَتِيم﴾ (is the one who repulses the orphan), i.e., he pushes him away harshly from his right.
﴿And does not urge﴾ himself or others ﴿to feed the poor﴾, meaning to feed him. It was revealed concerning al-'As ibn Wa'il or al-Walid ibn al-Mughira.
﴿Those who are heedless of their prayer﴾ are unmindful, delaying it beyond its time.
﴿Those who make a show of [their prayer]﴾, in the prayer and other than it.
[Quranic verse] "And they withhold small kindnesses." As the commentary explains, these are items such as the needle, the axe, the cooking pot, and the serving bowl.
